records.notes: Request acceptance only. No decoder or live endpoint capability is established. Explicit omission accepts legacy only. Accounts-only mode is not evaluated in this revision. Mutable upstream URLs are documentation references, not pinned implementation evidence.

rules.notes: Compares a package rust-version with an explicitly selected SBF compiler version. A host rustc observation is not substituted for the SBF compiler.

rules.rule_name: Anchor CLI and program crate alignment
rules.notes: Compares the selected Anchor CLI with resolved anchor-lang. Anchor release guidance updates the CLI and framework packages together; mismatched release lines are advisory warnings.
Reads supplied ELF metadata. Deployment policy is evaluated only for an explicit dated or conditional target.
The reviewed sBPFv3 recipe requires cargo-build-sbf 4.2+, platform-tools 1.53+, Pinocchio 0.10+ where used, and solana-define-syscall 2.3+ where used.

Checks two Pinocchio source boundaries against the resolved release: 0.10 replaces Pubkey/AccountInfo with Address/AccountView, and 0.11 requires a mutable AccountView slice and moves resize support behind explicit traits/features.
Reviewed V1 read support: @solana/web3.js 1.99.x, @solana/web3.js 3.0.0-rc.3 through 3.x, and @solana/kit 8.x. Exact resolved versions are required.
Compares resolved anchor-lang and anchor-spl versions. Mismatches are advisory because compatibility can be release-specific.
Recognizes legacy Anchor IDLs and the metadata.spec IDL introduced with Anchor 0.30. Unknown schemas and unreviewed reader combinations remain unknown.
